test.//view: llmlint: ignore-block[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] this tier's journeys never ask for the view, but they compile the same `e2e` test binary into the same target directory as every other tier, and `build.rs` embeds `apps/dag-ui/dist` into it: a run of this tier without the view would compile a bundle-less binary there that the next tier rebuilds, which is the thrash tests/e2e/ensure_sibling.rs holds every other tier to the same edge to prevent. `dag-ui:build` is cached by Nx, so a run that does not change the view pays nothing for it.
